Name: HealAssist
Author: monkdim
Punchline: One button raise targeting and lowest HP targeting for healers.
Description:
/harez targets the highest-priority raisable dead player. /halow targets the player with the lowest HP percentage. These commands can optionally consider alliance members and nearby players. Your macro casts the spell, or you can enable automatic raise casting.

/hatbn is a dedicated Dark Knight macro command: it casts The Blackest Night on the lowest-HP eligible living party member below 80% HP, otherwise yourself. It never targets other alliance parties or nearby players, regardless of your other targeting settings. Copy its two-line icon-and-command macro from the Macros tab; do not add an /ac line.
